jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Part Time Driver Mobile Inspection in Austin, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Retail/Malls, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As an Unarmed Patrol Officer at a retail and mall location, you will conduct routine patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and provide exceptional customer service and communication. This driving position requires a valid driver's license in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements. Join a caring, agile, reliable, and innovative team that puts people first, delivers through teamwork, and acts with integrity.

Position Type: Part Time

 Pay Rate: $20.60 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeWed10:00 PM - 04:00 AMThur10:00 PM - 04:00 AMFri10:00 PM - 04:00 AMSat10:00 PM - 04:00 AM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to tenants, shoppers, visitors, and/or staff while carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities as appropriate.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols throughout the retail property, including common areas, parking areas, walkways, and perimeter locations, to help deter unauthorized activity and identify security-related concerns.
  • Respond to incidents, customer concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following site-specific reporting and escalation procedures.
  • Observe and report unusual activity, property damage, maintenance concerns, and/or policy violations to appropriate site contacts and Allied Universal leadership.
  • Maintain accurate activity logs, incident reports, and patrol documentation in accordance with site requirements.

Minimum Requirements

  • A valid driver’s license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
  • Experience in loss prevention is preferred.
  • Comfort using a computer or tablet is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Security Officer, Overnight
jobs.description:
Grow with us...

Life at Starwood Hotels is based on a simple idea: the world is beautiful and we want to keep it that way. But we can’t do it alone. That’s why hiring thoughtful and inspiring Team Members and Leaders who understand that our people, collaboration, stellar service, and respect for nature are so important to us.

Main Duties

The Loss Prevention Officer is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment throughout the property by proactively identifying risks, enforcing safety and security policies, responding to incidents, and providing support to guests and team members. This role balances vigilance with hospitality, ensuring safety is upheld without compromising the guest experience.

General Duties

  • Patrol hotel property, both interior and exterior, to observe people, conditions, and activities, ensuring compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable laws.
  • Maintain fixed posts or conduct mobile patrols as assigned to monitor activity and prevent theft, vandalism, or unsafe behavior.
  • Enforce safety and security procedures to ensure a safe environment for guests, residents, visitors, and team members.
  • Monitor and control access to restricted areas, including back-of-house spaces.
  • Respond promptly to calls for service, assess situations, take appropriate action, and communicate status updates to management.
  • Perform crowd control and scene management during incidents, events, or emergencies.
  • Gather accurate and complete information related to incidents, accidents, or security concerns and prepare detailed reports.
  • Execute Lost & Found procedures in accordance with company standards.
  • Monitor employee and vendor access, report unauthorized access, and log vendors and visitors as required.
  • Escort guests, team members, and valuables as needed using the most efficient and discreet routes.
  • Respond to incidents involving disturbances, threats, or acts of violence in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.
  • Detain individuals when necessary and permitted, following established protocols.
  • Provide medical assistance, including First Aid, CPR, and AED use, within the scope of training until emergency responders arrive.
  • Maintain knowledge of the location and condition of emergency equipment and medical kits; report deficiencies promptly.
  • Assist with emergency evacuations and life safety procedures as required.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally via radio, phone, and in person, using proper radio etiquette and codes.
  • Maintain a professional, calm, and courteous demeanor at all times, regardless of external pressures.
  • Promote a positive guest experience while enforcing safety and security standards.
  • Look for opportunities to assist guests, colleagues, and other departments whenever possible.
  • Attend required training sessions and apply learned knowledge to daily operations.
  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; properly store flammable materials.
  • Ensure compliance with hotel policies, procedures, and standards with self and colleagues.
  • Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional.
  • Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information.
  • Embody the 1 Hotels Vision, Mission and Compass; deliver on Our Promise, provide Good-Natured Service and uphold our Brand Pillars.

Qualifications & Skills

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Prior experience in security, loss prevention, military, or law enforcement preferred.
  • Luxury hotel or resort experience strongly preferred.
  • Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • CPR, First Aid, and AED certification required (or ability to obtain).
  • Alcohol Awareness certification required (or ability to obtain).
  • Any required state or local security licenses must be obtained and maintained.
  • Must successfully complete company-required security training and annual assessments.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; additional languages a plus.
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to de-escalate situations calmly and professionally.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure in fast-paced environments.
  • Strong observation, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • High level of integrity, discretion, and confidentiality.
  • Proficiency with basic computer systems, security software, reporting tools, and mobile devices.
  • Ability to stand, walk, and patrol indoors and outdoors for extended periods.
  • Ability to sit, kneel, bend, crouch, and climb stairs as required.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to respond quickly to emergencies and physically demanding situations.
  • Ability to work in varying environmental conditions.

As a mission-driven company, our purpose is our true north, and our compass guides the way. The purpose we live by impacts the lives of our team members, drives the experiences for our guests, builds community with like-minded travelers and takes care of the planet we live in. Founded in 2006 by Barry Sternlicht, Starwood Hotels is a luxury hotel brand management company and affiliate of global private investment firm Starwood Capital Group.

Starwood Hotels is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in a diverse, sustainable workforce with an empowered, inclusive culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis covered under applicable law. If you require any special accommodations, please visit People Operations.

jobs.title: 78738 1st Shift Security Officer
jobs.description:
78738 1st Shift Security Officer


Security personnel on this site are responsible for protecting students, staff, visitors, and school property while supporting the district’s safety policies and emergency preparedness. Their duties vary by role but generally include the following:

1. Patrol and Monitoring

  • Regularly patrol school buildings, grounds, parking lots, and event areas to deter crime, prevent disorder, and detect suspicious activity
  • Monitor entrances, exits, and restricted areas to control access and ensure only authorized persons enter
  • Maintain a visible presence to deter inappropriate behavior

2. Visitor Management

  • Screen and verify visitors’ identities and purposes before granting entry

3. Incident Response and Investigation

  • Respond promptly to trespassers
  • Investigate unauthorized persons or vehicles entering the site
  • Assist in crisis situations

4. Emergency Preparedness

  • Maintain emergency response plans, including hold-in-place, secured perimeter, and reunification procedures

5. Collaboration and Communication

  • Work with school administrators to enforce safety policies and maintain order
  • Coordinate with local law enforcement and fire departments for security and emergency response

6. Documentation and Reporting

  • Keep detailed logs and reports of daily activities, incidents, and security system checks
  • Submit incident reports to the appropriate authorities

7. Compliance and Policy Enforcement

  • Enforce school rules and regulations to maintain a safe environment.
  • Follow state laws, district policies, and any posted orders or training requirements.


At United Protective Services, our people are our greatest asset. We are looking for reliable, positive people who want to serve others, and grow in their security careers. In return, we provide training, support, and opportunities you need to succeed.
